name: Steal A Verity!
desc:
Welcome to Steal A Verity!

How to Play:
😈Steal boxes from Monster Verity!
📦Open boxes to get Verity Pets!
💰 Earn money from your Verity Pets!
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
😈Steal boxes from other players
✨ Become the RICHEST on the server!

⭐ Like + Favorite for updates!
